description: Offline challenge 1 started through the ImGui challenge launch (matchStartFromChallenge) by --launch-challenge 0 (finding 10 of the multiplayer week plan). Challenge 1 is Combat on Skedar with teams on and, for one player, one MeatSim; the table was positional for the N64 structs until ea187a63, so every value after stage_id and head_id landed in the wrong field and slots 8 to 31 were enabled MeatSims, and the ImGui launch added no simulants. Proves the applied config (stage, scenario, limits), the simulant count for one player, and a full match to its end screen. The time limit is forced to 35 s.

input_sequence.comment: The boot drops into CI, --launch-challenge fires matchStartFromChallenge(0) once the CI player exists, the 35 s match runs to its time limit and the end screen.
Scripted clean exit; the boot, the Skedar load, the 35 s match and the end screen fit well inside, as in the local scenario smokes.
